note: Someone who plays with it all the time. The ceiling, not the typical owner.
label: an enthusiast
sources: Total: Bentley et al. 2018 (IMWUT), super-user cluster (8 of 88 homes), about 5.9 sessions a day
Ceiling check: company claims of 60+ interactions a day (bibo, ThePaper Oct 2026) count single interactions from active users only, so they overstate typical use
Novelty: Cagiltay et al. 2022, Weiss et al. 2021
Long term: assumed to stay engaged (floor 0.8), like the long-term AIBO owners in Kertesz & Turunen 2017
